units: <cite ref="Shabbat 138b:9">Sabb. 138ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ זו וכ׳</he> this peculiarity of punishment (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 28:59">Deut. XXVIII, 59</cite>) &c.; <he>ה׳ זו תורה</he> it means the Law (afflictions causing the Law to be forgotten, ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 29:14">Is. XXIX, 14</cite>).

senses.gloss: distinct and solemn specification of a vow (from Lev. XXVII, 2; Num. VI, 2; v. אִיסְפְּלִיאָה).
units: Tosef. Naz. III, 19 לא ניתנה נזירות אלא לה׳ the law of the nazir’s vow applies only to distinct utterance (where there is no doubt); Naz. 34ᵃ; a. e.—

Ib. 62ᵃ of the two ki yafli (Lev. l. c. Num. l. c.) אחד ה׳ לאיסור ואחד ה׳ וכ׳ one intimates a distinct binding expression, and one a distinctness which opens the way to absolution (v. הֲָטָה); Ḥag. 10ᵃ אחת ה׳ וכ׳.
